jobs.description:
About CF Assurance (CF A)
Our mission at Controlling and
Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent
foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of
the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our
expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an
inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop
professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious,
humble and open – define how we work together as a department.
To deliver on our vision of
being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a
unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong
learning and encourage our people towards continuous upskilling as a natural
part of their career. This is your chance to build your network within the
company and become part of a diverse, international and innovative team.
About CF A Internal Control (IC)
CF A Internal Control (IC) is
the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.
We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a
state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with
corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally
harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.
As Siemens transforms
into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.
We are looking for a
dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.
Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.
What You'll Do:

- Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI): Ideate, design, and
implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You
will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control
effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.
- Shape the Future of Internal Controls Methodology: Be part of the team responsible for the
effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.
- Own and Evolve the IC Framework: Take responsibility
for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.
- Enable and Empower the Global IC Community: Coach ICS
professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control
system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and
emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.
- Develop and Deliver Training & Guidance: Create and deliver
Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to
support the global rollout of methodologies and tools, fostering a culture
of continuous learning and excellence.
- Collaborate with the External Auditor: Align and discuss
Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to
ensure compliance and best-practice alignment.
- Keep Management informed: Understand global
patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.
- Contribute Beyond IC: Engage with the
broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":

- Strong Academic Foundation: Degree in business
administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally
a master’s degree.
- Proven IC & IT Controls Expertise: Extensive professional experience in Internal Control (including ICFR) with
a focus on IT controls. You understand the role IT systems
like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT
Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls
(ITGCs).
- Passion for Innovation & GenAI: Strong interest and
ideally hands-on experience in Generative AI and its
application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and
pilot GenAI use cases that drive automation, intelligence, and efficiency
in internal controls and risk management.
- Curiosity for other relevant Technologies: Genuine interest in
topics like RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML, and their potential
benefits and challenges in ICFR and ICSR environments. You stay current
with technological trends and are eager to experiment and learn.
- Growth Mindset: You enjoy taking on
new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are
comfortable pioneering new approaches.
- International & Intercultural Experience: Work experience in
an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a
strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
- Adaptability & Results Orientation: You impress with
your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus
on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
- Excellent Communication Skills: Strong
communication skills in German and English (written and
spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
- Digital Proficiency: Very good MS Office skills and comfort working with digital tools and
platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new
technologies is essential.

Why Join Us?

- Contribute to strategic initiatives around GenAI, digital business, and innovation in the context of internal controls.
- Work at the intersection of governance, technology, and innovation, shaping the future of internal controls in
a global technology leader.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge
technologies like GenAI, and the chance to grow your career across
Siemens.
- Join a diverse, international, and inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold
thinking.

Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2

Location: Global

Department: DI AUT OPS MF MLM GCE-M2

Job Grade: non senior management / ÜT fähig

Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time & Part-time

GRIP: QM-SQ-SUPQU-MA999 / Supplier Quality Management

External Posting?: No

Hiring Manger: Johanna Schiemann

The official start of this Leadership role is planned for October 1st 2026. As part of our transformation towards ONE Tech Company it plays a key role in shaping the future of our organization.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

Transform the everyday.

This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.

In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Education & Professional Foundation

- You hold a university degree or an equivalent qualification gained through practical experience in engineering, industrial engineering, business administration, supply chain management, or a related field. Most importantly, you have a proven ability to connect technical quality, supplier management, business impact, and international execution.

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.

Methodological Expertise

- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:
- Process FMEA
- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)
- 8D Problem Solving
- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
- 5 Why Analysis
- Pareto Analysis
- Process Audits
- Corrective Action Management
- Lessons Learned Processes
- Control Plans
- KPI and Performance Reviews
- Structured Escalation Processes

Communication & Collaboration

- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Please note, this position will be based in the Siemens location where the selected candidate currently is located. The role has been assessed as a level (MA999). The actual compensation range will vary based on work location, applicable salary structure, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Candidates will receive compensation information relevant to their location during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements and Siemens compensation practices. For further information regarding the compensation details that apply to you and your country, please contact the recruiter directly.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.

As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. Collaborative ecosystems help create and use innovative methods for better assurance. We offer an inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop professionally and personally. - Expertise & Skills: - Comprehensive IT risk expertise, including general IT controls audits and IT governance across diverse IT infrastructures such as Cloud environments,  ERP systems, operating systems, databases, networks and security tools. - Languages: Fluency in English, German is a plus. - Additional: Flexibility to travel (up to 20%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.

As part of our team, you will have: - A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week. - Attractive remuneration package and relocation support (if needed).- CF A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth.- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family.- Access to employee share plans.

Since each of over 300,000 employees feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) . jobs.occupation: Supplier Quality Engineer (f/m/d) for Mechanical Auxiliary Systems (Steel Fabrications) (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for Auxiliary Systems (Fluid Systems) of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global Supply Chain network. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Mechanical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes turbine air inlet, exhaust duct, expansion joint, enclosures, exhaust stack, heat exchangers, and other large, welded steel fabrications.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and product inspections for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification. Inspection types include visual, dimensional, weld, coating, pressure, traceability, quality records.
* Supplier Qualification and Development: Perform routine audits according to supplier risk categorization and audit program. Support supplier evaluation and commodity strategy definition. Implement supplier quality improvement programs or risk mitigation measures.
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary.
* Digitalization & Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality & Development tools and databases. E.g. to create process transparency or periodically generate supplier quality performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above.
* Knowledge and experience in auditing. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Knowledge in the application of quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, RCA.
* Familiarity with the following technologies & standards (or equivalents) are an advantage:
- Design of steel fabrications (AISC 360, EN 1090‑2, ASME VIII, B31.1, PED, API 661)
- Welding (AISC 360, AWS D1.1/ D1.2/ D1.6, ASME IX, ISO 3834, ISO 15614, ISO 5817, ISO 9606)
- Coating & surface preparation (SSPC, ISO 12944, ISO 8501, ISO 8502)
- Inspection methods (Visual Inspection, Penetrant Testing, Magnetic Particle, Ultrasonic Testing, Radiographic Testing)
- Material cleaning & preservation (ASTM A380M)
- Certifications in respective technology fields (NDT Level II or III, AMPP/ NACE CIP, FROSIO, AWS CWI/ SCWI, CSWIP 3.1/ 3.2, IWE, AWS CWEng)
* Willingness to travel as required for the role (approximately 35%) as well as strong communication skills in English.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Eurodrone Overall RPAS Technical Manager (d/f/m) (Technische/r Direktor/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Chief Engineering Eurodrone team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Eurodrone Overall RPAS Technical Manager (d/f/m)

Eurodrone Programme – Shaping the future of UAS

With its groundbreaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. European MALE RPAS is not just the first programme to fully implement digital design manufacturing and services (DDMS). It is also seen as a ‘light-house’ programme, not only within Airbus, but also for the entire aeronautics industry in Europe.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Technically lead and direct the overall planning and implementation to ensure the readiness and conduction of Eurodrone Phase 1C activities across all contributing organizations - including top level planning of all maintenance and RPAS updates from an overall perspective:

- Secure Flight Test Readiness of the involved test centres in Germany, Italy and Spain (e.g., training, logistics, airworthiness, operations, resources, processes).
- Provide leadership, guidance and direction on any aspects related to the maintenance, preparation and future support of the Eurodrone test fleet, associated activities (including potential FTI updates).
- Lead the installation/maintenance of a strategic fleet program.
- Support program teams to produce all technical documentations for future options.
- Act as technical customer interface for GFx management and loan requests for the use of GFx assets.
- Priories and steers equipment, GSTE and FTI spares distribution across Test Centres (Benches and RPAS prototypes), including repair management and availability of export licenses in coordination with equipment management, procurement and logistic teams.
- Execute overall management of extant or potential Cross-Program conflicts
- As the Eurodrone Engineering focal point, provide and take full responsibility for Major Asset Activity Reporting (RPAS, Benches and Equipment/Spares for BT, GT, FT, DTIS and IDTTs), supporting the program and customer reporting process (status and issues).

- Lead adaptation of contract, if and when required.
- Coordinates and chairs: BT, GT and FT Functional Reviews (e.g., IRR, TRR, VR, FFR, Co-TRR), integrated within the Eurodrone meetings cycle, providing Program and Customer Representatives full visibility of the status of each test program

- the status of the BT, GT and FT program
- the status of the Eurodrone test fleet
- issues relevant to maintaining the availability of the test fleet to support present and future Eurodrone contracts.

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Minimum of 8 - 10 years of experience in Flight Test Management of multinational programs, preferably in the multinational Test Center environment.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience aerospace test and verification, with a strong focus on RPAS/UAS or complex aircraft systems.
- Proven experience in leading and managing technical teams in a demanding aerospace environment.
- In-depth knowledge of flight test methodologies, data acquisition systems, and flight test instrumentation.
- Strong understanding of aerospace safety regulations, airworthiness requirements, and certification processes (e.g., EASA, MIL-STD) with national airworthiness authorities.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders.
- Proficiency in German and fluency in English is required
- Spanish or Italian is a plus.
- Ability to travel as required for test campaigns and meetings.

jobs.occupation: Java / Golang Senior Cloud Software Engineer (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Liebherr-Digital Development Center GmbH in Ulm develops digital
solutions for the entire Liebherr Group. Our passionate team from the
areas of software development, engineering and data science works
together on various projects from the whole Liebherr product world.
Our mission: creating outstanding digital experiences! Your
responsibilities Understand the business – Assess and support the
business objectives for digital products and services from a Cloud
Applications point of view Define the architecture – Create
structures of distributed systems in close collaboration with other
experts Implement cloud services – Develop holistic software modules
Support deployment – Care about continuous integration and
deployment processes Collaborate in interdisciplinary teams – Being
an enthusiastic agile team member Ensure DevOps – You build it, you
run it. Your qualifications M.Sc. Computer Science and at least 7
years experience in Java or Golang software development Confident use
of agentic AI tools for workflow automation, problem-solving, and
software development Proficiency in development of distributed
software, cloud mechanisms, tooling and providers (Azure, AWS,
Container, Kubernetes etc.) Experience with Infrastructure as Code &
continuous integration and DevOps Proficiency with storage
technologies (SQL DB, NoSQL DB, Data Lake, etc.) Familiarity with
Clean Code, Peer Review and Pair Programming High degree of motivation
& ability to collaborate in agile teams Excellent spoken and written
communication skills in German & English Our offer A challenging and
interesting range of activities awaits you at Liebherr in an
internationally successful Group. We offer you a secure job with the
social contributions of a modern organisation and pay a
performance-based salary. Reference 82260 Standort Liebherr-Digital
Development Center GmbH Konrad-Zuse-Straße 4 89081 Ulm Deutschland
Kontakt Liebherr-Digital Development Center GmbH
Franziska.Rolle@liebherr.com

What you do.

Key Responsibilities

AI Implementation & Deployment (ca. 75%)

- You design, build, and deploy production-ready AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact — from intelligent automation and AI agents to predictive analytics and generative AI applications
- You move fast, taking ideas from prototype to production, using modern frameworks (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen) and foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs)
- You integrate AI into existing business systems via APIs and data pipelines, ensure safe and reliable operation through governance and monitoring, and optimise performance and costs for commercial viability
- You work embedded within client organisations to understand real processes, drive adoption, and enable AI-led change

Business Process Transformation (15%)

- Map current business processes understanding how work gets done today, identifying bottlenecks, and spotting automation opportunities
- Design AI-enabled future states working with your Deployment Strategist and client stakeholders to reimagine processes with AI capabilities
- Assess AI feasibility evaluating which problems are well-suited for AI, which approaches to use, and what ROI to expect
- Define success metrics working with your strategist partner to establish measurable outcomes that demonstrate business value
- Collaborate on use case prioritisation helping identify which AI opportunities deliver the highest impact relative to implementation complexity

Technical Pre-Sales & Demonstration (10%)

- Build rapid AI prototypes creating working demonstrations of AI capabilities in prospect-specific contexts within days
- Demonstrate AI possibilities showing prospective clients what AI can do for their specific business challenges with concrete examples
- Provide technical credibility establishing trust with client technical and business leaders through demonstrated AI expertise
- Assess client AI readiness evaluating data quality, technical infrastructure, and organisational capability to support AI initiatives

What you bring along.

- Strong AI/ML implementation experience (2+ years) building and deploying production AI systems, with hands-on expertise in LLMs and generative AI (GPT-4, Claude, Llama), including prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, and AI agent development (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar)
- Strong Python skills, solid data engineering capabilities (pipelines, vector databases, ETL), API and integration experience, and practical ML foundations (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
- Proven experience shipping AI systems to production, with cloud infrastructure knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP incl. GPU/serverless), full-stack development around AI applications, DevOps/MLOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, model versioning), and performance optimisation across cost, latency, and scalability
- Strong business outcome focus, rapid iteration mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and clear communication with non-technical stakeholders
- Comfortable with change management, close collaboration with a Deployment Strategist, and selecting the right AI approach for the business problem
- Speed-oriented and autonomous execution, learning agility in a fast-evolving AI landscape, travel flexibility, entrepreneurial mindset, and ethical AI awareness (safety, bias, privacy)

Essential Requirements

- University degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
- Portfolio of production AI/ML systems you've built and deployed
- Fluent English (written and spoken) - additional languages (German, Spanish) are valuable for DACH and Spain regions
- Legal right to work in the region of employment (UK and EU)
